blocks.text: MABALACAT CITY, Pampanga— The police arrested a Nigerian who was allegedly in possession of ecstasy pills worth an estimated P5.96 million during a buy-bust operation in Barangay Balibago, Angeles City late Friday night. In a statement on Saturday, the Angeles City police said the 46-year-old Nigerian national is on the list of “high-value individuals” under the government’s campaign against illegal drugs. It said combined operatives from the Angeles City police and regional police units conducted the buy-bust along 1st Street in Barangay Balibago around 10:30 p.m. Using marked peso bills, an undercover police officer bought a few ecstasy tablets from the […]...
